1. Various federal laws and regulations restrict the post-government employment activities of former military personnel and federal government employees. The Post-Government Employment Certification (GC489) is designed to assist Acme in assessing which restrictions, if any, apply to you.*

2. Section 847 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2008 (Pub. L. No. 110-181) requires certain current and former Department of Defense (DoD) ofﬁcials or employees, including any agency, command or organization of the DoD, as well as the military departments, to seek and obtain a written ethics opinion regarding the applicability of post-employment restrictions to activities they may undertake on behalf of a contractor.
